title: You`re Nowhere
author: Sulekha Sarkar
text:
You`re nowhere
so I have nothing to do, there`s
nothing to talk to anyone about ;
silent I, bear the burden of
loves birth and death.

With the sunrise I will be free
so I tear the bloodline map from
my hand and stick it to your body.
Your fingers are swinging...
You are shining again and then
walk away to another stage
like a musical drama.

You`re nowhere
so there is no wound in me or
I`m not in the wound.
